title: Mask Adoption Diffusion Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior emerges and spreads through a population under social influence, policy mandates, enforcement, communication, and supply constraints.

interactions.name: social_influence
interactions.description: Persons influence each other's mask attitude and wearing via network contacts and observed behavior.

interactions.name: household_influence_and_sharing
interactions.description: Households shape member norms and redistribute mask inventory among members.

interactions.name: policy_compliance_and_enforcement
interactions.description: Venues apply mask policies; authority inspections may enforce compliance through warnings or fines.

interactions.name: information_campaign
interactions.description: Authority broadcasts messages that adjust risk perception and trust, affecting adoption.

interactions.name: mask_purchase_supply
interactions.description: Persons buy masks from retailers; stock levels and prices influence purchase success and future wearing.

interactions.name: venue_observation_effect
interactions.description: Observed mask use at venues updates individual norms and wearing probability.

metrics.name: adoption_rate
metrics.description: Proportion of persons wearing a mask at each time step.

metrics.name: cumulative_adopters
metrics.description: Share of persons who have worn a mask at least once by time t.

metrics.name: time_to_50_percent_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days until adoption_rate first reaches or exceeds 50%.

metrics.name: policy_effect_on_adoption
metrics.description: Change in average adoption_rate before vs. after mandate activation.

metrics.name: adoption_inequality_by_income
metrics.description: Disparity (e.g., Gini or high–low income gap) in adoption across income groups.

metrics.name: average_masks_sold_per_day
metrics.description: Mean number of masks sold by retailers per day.

metrics.name: stockout_days
metrics.description: Total days with at least one retailer experiencing zero stock.

metrics.name: enforcement_actions_count
metrics.description: Number of inspections, warnings, or fines issued.

metrics.name: venue_compliance_rate
metrics.description: Average proportion of entrants complying with mask rules at mandated venues.

metrics.name: message_reach_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of persons exposed to authority messages per day.
